d: Short, spiky violet hair with long bangs and a messy texture, paired with sharp, narrow crimson eyes and a youthful, mature appearance. The build is slender with a toned midriff. The outfit consists of a white cropped top under a dark navy open jacket with silver accents, short black shorts with a belt and a silver hip chain, black fingerless gloves, and black lace-up heeled boots. Signature details include a large black futuristic railgun held over the shoulder and a golden cord tied into the hair.
